Sustained effect supports less frequent dosing and potential adherence advantage.

Mechanistic validation reduces target risk and supports dose selection.

Early clinical proof-of-concept in a small, short Phase I patient cohort; promising but preliminary. A larger, longer Phase II with PASI75/90 rates and safety vs placebo/active control is needed for a true value inflection.
